metadata.normalization: sum FFT coefficient/channel contributions divided once by N**4*3; count columns are unnormalized
metadata.r_definition: max(abs(fx),abs(fy)); bin=floor(32*r); bin16 is r=0.5 Nyquist edge

fits.A: one real w per image/seed/r-bin, shared RGB
fits.C: one real w per image/seed/Fourier point, shared RGB
fits.D: one real w per image/seed/Fourier point/channel

metadata.non_nesting: B and C are not nested. Their difference is not an additive decomposition.
metadata.fit_target: Pm; real unregularized least squares fitted to native and perturbed outputs from same example

definitions.D_quadrature: for nonzero P: |Pm|^2*sin^2(arg(Pm)-arg(P)); negative real gain (pi phase) is fitted, not in this residual

small_power_guard.effect: flag only; no truncation, epsilon clipping, or gain clipping
small_power_guard.zero_case: w=0 only when group native power exactly zero; residual retained

metadata.interpretation: Descriptive fitted-subspace energy accounting, not causal attribution or prospective prediction. Quadrature is geometric, not a proven phase mechanism. Saved float16 outputs may have quantization-level spectral residues.
metadata.prediction_precision: frozen float16 cast float64; target float32 /255 then float64 FFT; no clipping
